methods_en: Use 48 paired trajectories with common random numbers, each 4,000 tokens long, and average TV over the last 1,000 tokens of each trajectory. Intervals of 1/2/4/8/16 tokens use λ=0.025/0.05/0.10/0.20/0.40, holding nominal dose at 0.025/token. Bootstrap the paired trajectory difference between every-1 and every-16.
results_en: Late TV across the five intervals was 0.3931/0.3965/0.3946/0.3975/0.3935, versus 0.4162 for free generation. The range of the five means was 0.0044. Every-1 minus every-16 was −0.00047, with bootstrap 95% CI [−0.00996,0.00893].
interpretation_en: Cumulative dose is the main supported explanation in this world; matched-dose outcomes are similar across 1–16-token intervals. Irreversible writes, saturation or missed control windows can be studied with the same separation of dose and timing.
